recognize_zh: 視野中絕大多數紅血球中央淡染區都呈狹長裂隙（口形紅血球，stomatocyte）；中央偏右、箭頭左側有一顆與紅血球等大、布滿紫色細顆粒的巨大血小板，口形紅血球加巨大血小板要想到植物固醇血症（sitosterolemia）。
features: Majority of red cells are stomatocytes with a single elongated slit-like central pallor
Giant platelet left of the arrow, comparable in size to a red cell, with evenly distributed purple granules
Few round discocytes with normal central pallor; occasional larger, irregular cells
Very few normal-sized platelets in the field
No schistocytes, spherocytes or nucleated red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of stomatocytes, most red cells having a single elongated slit-like central pallor, with only a few round discocytes. A giant platelet comparable in size to a red cell, with evenly distributed purple granules, is present to the left of the arrow, and normal-sized platelets are sparse in this field. Schistocytes, spherocytes and nucleated red cells are not seen. The combination of prominent stomatocytosis and macrothrombocytes suggests sitosterolemia or a hereditary stomatocytosis syndrome, and correlation with platelet count, plasma plant sterols and red cell indices is recommended. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis with giant platelets.

ddx.vs: Artifactual slits are limited to thick areas, whereas this population is present across a thin monolayer with well-separated cells.
Giant platelets are present but red cells lack stomatocytosis; MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.
Shares stomatocytes but typically has normal-sized platelets, with hemolysis and abnormal cation flux on specialized testing.
